Name: Pray To Yoba
Author: Sable17
Description:
[size=5][quote][size=4][color=#f1c232][b]Yoba [/b][/color]is with you. What do you pray for?[/size][/quote][/size]Once every [b]Sunday[/b], you can [b][u]sit[/u] [/b]in front of the Altar to [color=#f1c232][b]Yoba [/b][/color]in Pierre's shop to pray to Yoba.

[b][color=#f1c232]-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/color][/b]
[b][size=4][color=#f1c232]Yoba[/color]'s Blessings[/size][/b]

To Pray to Yoba, simply [b]sit [/b]on one of the stools in front of the Altar, and choose your prayer:

    [color=#f6b26b][b]Friendship [/b][/color]- "You feel closer to everyone in the valley."
    ﻿ ﻿~ 10 friendship points with everyone you currently know.
  [color=#f6b26b] [b] My Animals[/b][/color]- "The love of your animals fills your heart."
    ﻿﻿~ 30 friendship points with your animals (pets included!), and they're all "petted" for the day.
    [color=#f6b26b][b]Wealth [/b][/color]- "Yoba smiles upon your hard work."
    ﻿﻿~ Earn an extra 10% of what you ship that Sunday night. (Extra earnings are generated after you wake up. You'll see the notification.)
    [color=#f6b26b][b]Luck [/b][/color]- "You feel divinely guided."
    ﻿ ﻿~ +3 Luck for the rest of the day.
    [color=#f6b26b][b]Skill [/b][/color]- "Insight floods your mind."
    ﻿﻿~ +30 XP for each skill.
    [color=#f6b26b][b]Rain [/b][/color]- "Storm clouds gather in your hands."
    ﻿ ﻿~ Receive 1 rain totem.
    [color=#f6b26b][b]Nothing [/b][/color]- Sit in quiet contemplation. (This is just the "cancel" option, in case you want to choose later in the day or something.)
[b]
All of these can be edited in the config if something feels too strong/weak.
[/b]The config will be generated after running the game once.
[color=#f1c232][b]-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/b][/color]

[b]Requirements[/b]
• Stardew Valley 1.6+  
• SMAPI  

Inspired by the remake of my favorite HM game, A Wonderful Life, and its addition of wishes at the Starry Night Festival.

Should be compatible with most mods, as long as they don't move/remove the stools in front of Yoba's Altar.
(Mods in screenshot: Altar of Yoba replacement, Stardew Valley Expanded, Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn, VPR-Inspired UI)
